comportamentos: ResearchLine model belonging to ResearchArea (name required and unique, research_area required): present, but the candidate also requires a `code` column that the official fix removes, so records created without a code fail validation
research_lines table and enrollments.research_line_id column: present
ResearchArea has_many research_lines: present, but uses dependent: :restrict_with_exception instead of :destroy
Enrollment belongs_to research_line (optional), with the field in the form, list and search: present
Research line options in the enrollment form filtered by the selected research area: present, implemented differently through association conditions
If an enrollment has a line but no area, the area is inferred from the line: missing (the candidate raises a validation error instead)
Error when line and area differ: present but differs (error on :research_line with key research_line_not_from_research_area, instead of on :research_area with key different_research_areas)
ResearchLine CRUD controller, routes, navigation menu entry and ability permissions: present
`available` flag on research areas and research lines, with filtering of inactive ones: missing
ProfessorResearchLine and CourseResearchLine models, controllers and associations: missing
justificativa: The candidate implements the core line-within-area model and the filtered enrollment field, but adds a required `code`, does not infer the area from the line, uses different error keys, and omits the availability flags and the professor and course research-line associations from the official fix.
